Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.lifecycle

Class FieldLifecycleModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.lifecycle.FieldLifecycleModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FieldLifecycleModel extends Object implements Serializable
Assembled NeqSim model used by the field-lifecycle simulator.

The model provides explicit connection points between subsurface material balance and the surface process. The process model can be a normal ProcessSystem or a multi-area ProcessModel; detailed user-built flowsheets can therefore replace the reference model without changing the lifecycle simulator.

Version:
1.0

    • FieldLifecycleModel

      public FieldLifecycleModel(String name, SimpleReservoir reservoir, ProcessSystem processSystem, StreamInterface reservoirOilProducer, StreamInterface reservoirWaterProducer, StreamInterface reservoirGasInjector, StreamInterface recoveredGas, Splitter gasAllocationSplitter, StreamInterface stabilizedOilExport, StreamInterface gasExport, StreamInterface compressedInjectionGas, StreamInterface hostOilFeed, StreamInterface hostGasFeed, StreamInterface hostWaterFeed)
      Creates an assembled lifecycle model with explicit existing-host feed streams for tieback studies.

      The detailed ProcessSystem should mix these streams with the new-field SURF arrival stream upstream of shared processing equipment. The lifecycle simulator updates all three host rates every year before solving the combined process.

      Parameters:
      name - model/concept name
      reservoir - reservoir material-balance model
      processSystem - wells, SURF and shared-facility process model
      reservoirOilProducer - new-field oil producer stream
      reservoirWaterProducer - new-field water producer stream
      reservoirGasInjector - new-field gas injector stream
      recoveredGas - combined recovered gas upstream of allocation
      gasAllocationSplitter - gas export/injection splitter
      stabilizedOilExport - combined stabilized-oil product stream
      gasExport - combined sales-gas stream
      compressedInjectionGas - compressed injection-gas stream
      hostOilFeed - existing-host oil feed, or null for greenfield
      hostGasFeed - existing-host free-gas feed, or null for greenfield
      hostWaterFeed - existing-host water feed, or null for greenfield

    • builder

      public static FieldLifecycleModel.Builder builder(String name, SimpleReservoir reservoir, ProcessModel processModel, String facilityAreaName)
      Starts a connection-point builder for a user-supplied multi-area process model.

      The complete ProcessModel is executed and used for plant-wide power, sizing and bottleneck analysis. The named facility area is retained as the primary process system for backwards-compatible access and connection-point inspection.

      Parameters:
      name - lifecycle model name
      reservoir - mutable reservoir material-balance model
      processModel - detailed multi-area SURF and facility model
      facilityAreaName - process-area name containing the receiving facility
      Returns:
      connection-point builder

    • existingSurfAndFacility

      public static FieldLifecycleModel.Builder existingSurfAndFacility(String name, SimpleReservoir reservoir, ProcessSystem existingSurfSystem, ProcessSystem existingFacilitySystem)
      Starts a builder for a new-field tie-in through separate existing SURF and facility process systems.

      The two systems must already be connected by shared NeqSim streams. They are assembled into a ProcessModel so their topology is solved together and bottlenecks in the shared subsea system are visible alongside topsides constraints.
